summary: PACK01 R3 single approved correction implemented in pack_geo.py with 13 added tests (48 original Python intents retained; 61 total). Root defect reproduced first (RED: 8 failures + 1 error): the supplied R2 fixture overlap-packed-r2.json vs overlap-source.json yields the confirmed 0 -> 0.0008398721695581202 m^2 new intersection for the two wegdeel features, the witness interior point is covered by both polygons after packing, and isolated Point members of mixed Point/LineString boundary intersections were being dropped because _lineal_parts extracted only lineal geometry; no pairwise neighbour validation existed, so asymmetric Douglas-Peucker chord drops at shallow pinches let independent chords cross and enclose new area (and could bridge genuine near-neighbour gaps). Fix (additive two-pass safety, no buffering/repair/dissolve/feature-or-hole deletion/attribute change/extra rounding/relaxed bound): (1) _contact_parts now extracts both lineal and point contact parts; shared-boundary locking locks seam vertices AND isolated point contacts (exact vertex plus T-junction endpoint locking) on both neighbours, including holes and MultiPolygon components; (2) new fixed-point pass _enforce_neighbour_safety validates every mobile candidate against all bbox-intersecting ORIGINAL neighbours (bbox-only STRtree query is exhaustive because simplified vertices are a strict subset of original vertices, so candidate bboxes can never grow); pairs gaining interior area relative to the original intersection, uncovering a shared seam, or losing a point contact force every mobile side of the pair back to its COMPLETE unchanged original feature (reason recorded, distance 0.0); pre-existing overlaps between differently layered features only trip when NEW area appears. New tests cover the supplied real witness and general cases without hardcoding fixture IDs: PurePointContactSyntheticTests (pinches retained, zero area, BOTH features still simplify within 0.05000001 m, source-vertex subset), NearNeighbourGapGuardTests (source-valid disjoint strips with <0.02 m gap whose cut chords would cross; both features fall back polygon-identical to originals), MixedLineAndPointContactSyntheticTests (shared vertical runs plus weave pinch exactly covered), and RealMixedContactWitnessTests (7 tests: R2 fixture reproduces 0.0008398721695581202 m^2 and double coverage; new output intersection area is exactly 0.0 and stays exactly 0.0 after translation to the witness origin and 1000x scaling; witness point returns to single coverage; all source shared lineal runs and all 10 point contacts are difference-empty on both packed boundaries; properties verbatim including relatieve_hoogteligging -1 and 0 with IDs/order preserved; deterministic bytes, Hausdorff within bound, ring/polygon cardinality kept). Measured on the real witness pair alone: both roads still simplify (496 vertices removed, max Hausdorff 0.0490896640911805 m), neighbour guard checked 1 pair over 1 iteration and forced 0 features - the fix is additive for this pair rather than a blanket fallback. Measured sample-input.json run (53 features; this is the small parent-selected public subset, not city-wide evidence): input 229,408 B sha256 82d99e326853a1db63670179b0cb5c34f410347c6b7704d63b28fa525167397a; output JSON 170,695 B sha256 3932b03222c49a4acd3a976e4ceb1f8dbec949af91be2d52ee3d8a15e6872621; deterministic gzip (mtime 0, level 9) 50,199 B sha256 a8888d075a4eb8e5d355b5d8cccbd748915a76fa67c6695abd1635dbb7829a00; gunzip verified byte-identical; elapsed 0.10043529106769711 s; peak RSS 44,318,720 B. Vertices 6,617 -> 3,598 (3,019 removed); 28 features simplified, 19 unchanged, 6 conservatively retained complete and unchanged - every one for neighbour_contact_point_lost (bridges 2, roads 3, water 1; 0 invalid_original); max Hausdorff 0.049274049476768236 m <= 0.05000001 m guard. Shared-boundary locking: 50 lineal seam pairs, 1,505 locked seam vertices, 0 force_safe_features; point contacts: 9 point-contact pairs, 16 point contacts locked. Neighbour guard: 472 bbox candidate pairs checked over 3 fixed-point iterations, 6 features forced unchanged; eps thresholds 1e-12 m^2 new area and 1e-9 m uncovered seam length. Read-only geo-loader.js/test-geo-loader.cjs untouched (23/23 pass). This fixes a geometry coverage defect on supplied witnesses and public subsets only; it is not evidence of city-wide success - the old 11 zero-area pairs (including overbruggingsdeel/wegdeel, pand/wegdeel and the wegdeel/wegdeel witness) over 843,220 bbox neighbour pairs / 284,123 seam pairs require the independent parent full-source audit, and contact locking does not imply gameplay route connectivity.

memory_delta: Mixed polygon boundary intersections can be GeometryCollections of LineString plus Point members; extracting only lineal parts silently drops isolated pinch/point contacts, and asymmetric per-ring Douglas-Peucker vertex drops can then let independent chords cross and enclose new positive area even though the source intersection area was zero.

Pairwise candidate validation for vertex-subset simplification must query neighbours with a bbox-only spatial index over ORIGINAL geometries: candidates can never grow their bbox, while predicate='intersects' misses source-disjoint near neighbours whose cut chords could bridge the gap.

Conservative neighbour safety is expressible as a fixed point: each round checks new-interior-area (candidate intersection minus original intersection), uncovered shared-seam length and lost point contacts, then forces every mobile side of each unsafe pair back to the complete unchanged original; measuring area DELTA versus the original intersection preserves legitimate pre-existing overlaps between differently layered features.

Coverage witnesses must be verified under translation and uniform scale (1000x) and at single-point coverage granularity; fallback reasons must surface which guard tripped, and geometry corrections must never buffer, repair, dissolve, delete features/holes, alter attributes or relax the 0.05 m Hausdorff bound.
next_steps: Parent must run the independent full-source audit on all 145,703 features (843,220 bbox neighbour pairs; 284,123 shared seam pairs), repeating identity/properties/cardinality/source-vertex/0.05 m checks plus mixed Point/LineString contacts, neighbour new-area/gap coverage and the old 11 zero-area pair IDs from full-coverage-r2.json (overbruggingsdeel/wegdeel, pand/wegdeel and the wegdeel/wegdeel witness); sample results here must not be extrapolated to city-wide success.

Parent should measure full-source pack byte size, gzip size and packer/Chrome memory against the R2 baseline (397,004,443 B JSON / 101,347,149 B gzip; observed Chrome end heap 2.02-2.49 GB), noting the 6 conservative unchanged-feature fallbacks in this small sample and that geometry safety takes priority over soft size targets.
Parent makes the final gameplay/route judgment: preserved point and seam contacts are geometric coverage only and do not establish inter-feature network continuity.
